name: araabot-production-platform
description: AraaBot.in — AI Quantum Boost 500x Paper & Exness MT4/MT5 Live Trading Platform

scripts.setup: python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt || (python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt)
scripts.start: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -B -u run.py; else python3 -B -u run.py; fi
scripts.test: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v; else python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v; fi
